task_completion.description: Locate and open the 'Adobe Creative Cloud All Apps' license management view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the license details for 'Adobe Creative Cloud All Apps' specifically.

task_completion.description: Identify users currently holding seats who belong to Sales, Finance, or HR departments.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent scrolls through or filters the user list, showing users with department labels like 'Sales', 'Finance', or 'HR' assigned to the Adobe license.

task_completion.description: Revoke seats from all users in unauthorized departments (Sales, Finance, HR) before adding new ones.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the removal/revocation process (e.g., clicking 'Remove', 'Revoke', or 'Unassign') for users in the unauthorized departments.

task_completion.description: Identify users in 'Creative' and 'Marketing' departments who do not currently have a seat.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent views a list of employees or a 'provisioning' screen showing Creative/Marketing staff without the license.

task_completion.description: Assign seats to all users in the 'Creative' and 'Marketing' departments.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the assignment process (e.g., clicking 'Assign' or 'Add User') for Creative and Marketing staff, ensuring the total does not exceed 10.

integrity.description: The agent used the graphical user interface of the asset management software rather than terminal commands or scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows mouse movements, clicks, and menu navigation within the software UI; no terminal windows are used for the core task.

integrity.description: The agent did not modify seats for any software other than Adobe Creative Cloud All Apps.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent does not click 'Edit' or 'Remove' on other license entries like Microsoft 365 or Slack.

integrity.description: The agent actually looked up user department data within the system rather than guessing names.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent viewing user profiles or a department column in a table to verify affiliation.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target license is 'Adobe Creative Cloud All Apps' with a hard limit of 10 seats. Authorized departments are 'Creative' and 'Marketing'. Unauthorized departments that must be revoked are 'Sales', 'Finance', and 'HR'. The agent must revoke unauthorized seats first to ensure they do not exceed the 10-seat limit when adding authorized users.
